mode: Built-in image_gen; five independent candidates per replacement
direction: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one exceptionally polished editorial illustration for Pattern, an adult visual guide to machine learning. Genuine transparent PNG background, with clean alpha around every object; never draw a checkerboard. Compact wide horizontal composition, roughly 2.4:1, complete subjects and a small safety margin, no huge empty top or bottom. Color discipline: predominantly muted ice blue #9ebedc, misty lavender #c9b9f1, warm ivory #efeee9 and blue charcoal #28313e. Apricot #d4a58c may be a tiny accent, not a dominant gold/orange. No neon, forest green, cyan glow, brass plumbing, decorative pedestals, stock AI brains or robots. Sophisticated tactile detail, precise silhouettes, beautiful restrained lighting, satin surfaces and subtle real texture. The picture must explain a relationship, not merely decorate the page. Concise labels, when requested, must be typeset beautifully in a geometric sans serif like DM Sans, graphite ink on opaque ivory or pale blue surfaces so they are legible on both #141619 and #f3f2ef. Never float dark text directly on transparency. Do not add headings, badges, captions, watermark or text beyond requested labels. Scientific accuracy is more important than ornament. Render a finished high-resolution image, not a page mockup or a collage of alternatives.

Two carefully composed pairs of shoe studies across a wide transparent image. Left main subject a blue/ivory suede sneaker with a smaller monochrome rear-view photograph tucked behind it. A scientifically accurate three-part physical infographic made from three thin ivory plot sheets in shallow perspective. All three show exactly the same seven blue training dots around a gentle arch and three lavender hollow test dots. Left sheet labeled 'Underfit': one straight line misses the arch. Middle 'Useful fit': one smooth arch follows the broad trend and lies near held-out dots. Right 'Overfit': a visibly wiggly line passes through every blue dot but veers away from lavender test dots. Training dots solid, held-out dots hollow. Elegant tiny integrated legend 'Training' with solid dot and 'Unseen' with hollow dot on one shared narrow base. No numeric axes, no decorative graph grid. Sophisticated scientific clarity.

A tactile tailoring metaphor for overfitting, beautifully photographed cutouts in a horizontal triptych. Three ivory dressmaker forms of the same simple curved shape. First wears an overly stiff straight blue paper strip failing to follow the curve, middle a smooth lavender ribbon that follows the broad shape, third a jagged blue ribbon contorted around many tiny incidental pins. Tiny ivory tabs read 'Too simple', 'Useful pattern', 'Memorized detail'. Keep the metaphor very clear and restrained, no actual human bodies, no dress ornament; sculptural science editorial.

Three elegant small cards illustrate handwriting recognition generalization. Left 'Too simple': blurry generic digit silhouettes fail to distinguish a 3 from an 8. Middle 'Learns the shape': several varied handwritten 3s map to one clean handwritten 3, with a fresh different 3 joining the group. Right 'Memorizes the page': a single ornate handwritten 3 has every paper speck traced in blue while a new 3 beside it is left unmatched. Use real-looking monochrome MNIST-like handwriting in ivory inset windows, blue/lavender cards. Scientifically framed analogy; no accuracy percentages or invented metrics. Compact polished still life on transparency.

An exceptionally elegant top-down scientific triptych: three soft ivory chart tiles with identical sparse blue observations sampled around a sine-like arch. A charcoal ruler-straight stroke misses them on the first; one flowing blue ceramic spline captures their trend on the second; a wiry lavender spline twists through their individual noise on the third. Three peach hollow test points on every chart reveal which shape generalizes. Precise labels 'Underfit', 'Generalize', 'Overfit' printed into the tile margins. No axes, no numbers, no extraneous callouts. The right line must visibly fail near unseen points.

A conceptual scientific still life: three transparent-outline circular lenses suspended over the same blue point pattern on three ivory paper squares. Through first lens only a straight trend is visible, through second a smooth meaningful curve, through third a tangled curve chasing every speck. Integrated tabs 'Too little', 'Enough', 'Too much'. Lavender hollow points sitting just outside the main training pattern should be close only to the middle trend. Opaque pale backing behind labels, actual transparent outer backdrop. Restrained optics without shiny chrome, carefully controlled geometry, low wide composition.

A beautiful restrained scientific time-series ribbon crossing a clear 'Today' divider. Left, a single satin blue wave repeats three seasonal peaks over an ivory calendar strip. Right, the same repeating trend extends as a dashed lavender central path, surrounded by three delicate widening translucent bands, with increasing uncertainty toward the far right. Small integrated labels 'Observed' and 'Forecast' on the calendar strip. Transparent outer background; no giant enclosing chart, no fake dates, no numeric confidence percentages. The future wave continues the same rhythm and uncertainty begins narrow at Today. Elegant wide low infographic.

A refined still life about forecasting café demand. Left: three sequential small ivory weekly calendar pages each with the same rising and falling blue miniature bar pattern. A vertical pale lavender divider labeled 'Today'. Right: one next calendar page has pale blue predicted bars and thin lavender ranges above each; farther predictions have longer ranges. A single small ivory coffee cup establishes context. Printed labels 'Past weeks' and 'Next week'. No invented data values. Compact diagonal rhythm, tasteful photo-real paper texture, muted blue palette, isolated on transparency.

An elegant scientific landscape built from a single matte blue corrugated ribbon whose repeating peaks stand for seasonality. Its first two thirds are sharply defined; at a small ivory marker 'Now' the ribbon branches into three restrained lavender trajectories. The central branch continues the same repeating rhythm; upper and lower possibilities spread gradually apart. Two small ivory foot labels 'History' and 'Possible futures'. No magic glass machine, no floating galaxies, no neon. Crisp readable conceptual relationship, shallow three-quarter perspective, true transparent background.

A horizontal sequence of four beautiful small ceramic seasonal trees, cool blue branching spring, full ivory-blue summer canopy, muted lavender autumn canopy, bare slate winter branches. Beneath them an ivory paper time strip bears a smooth repeating blue wave. At the right a second spring tree is only a delicate lavender outline with two alternative canopy sizes, representing uncertain future. Printed labels on strip 'Observed seasons' and 'Forecast'. Scientific editorial metaphor for recurring cycles, botanical detail, no warm autumn orange dominance, no opaque full background.

A wide refined infographic styled as a scientific field notebook without its cover: one narrow ivory sheet with a blue time series formed from tiny measured dots and a smooth seasonal curve. At a clearly marked 'Today', solid observations stop and a lavender predicted curve continues inside a widening fan. The paper itself has an irregular elegant cutout silhouette, with two small inset magnified sections showing a repeating past peak and its forecast counterpart. Only labels 'Past', 'Today', 'Future'. No numerical axes or invented data, transparent around the page.

A sculptural top-down route-learning illustration: an ivory 5-by-5 tiled garden with a few blue stone obstacles, an apricot small starting bead at lower left and a lavender goal arch at upper right. Small printed labels on edge tiles 'Explore' near branching paths and 'Reward' near the destination. Clear connected walkable geometry, elegant terrain, no robot, no game UI, no random arrows. A sophisticated reinforcement-learning diptych using an identical small maze of ivory walls on blue paper. Left maze 'Early attempts' shows several thin lavender wandering paths, one dead end. True transparent outside both maze objects.

An elegant physical branching decision tree laid flat on transparency: ivory paths branch twice, with small matte blue stepping stones at choice points. Soft restrained studio light, paper and ceramic materials, refined complete composition.

A miniature blue-gray delivery bicycle, sophisticated architectural-model scale, beside a compact network of ivory street tiles with three lavender buildings. A dotted blue route tries one blocked street, then bends toward a clearly reachable destination carrying a small apricot parcel. Discrete inset ivory labels 'Action', 'Result', 'Next choice' attached to three stages along the route. Educational reinforcement learning metaphor, no human figures, no cartoon proportions, no childish toy gloss. The street network is visually coherent and not cluttered.

A clear scientific editorial illustration of trial and improvement: three shallow ivory trays in a row contain the same blue ball and same two-obstacle course. Left the ball's lavender dashed route collides with first obstacle; center it bypasses first but hits second; right a smooth blue path bypasses both and reaches a tiny apricot target. Integrated tray labels 'Try', 'Observe', 'Improve'. All same start, target and obstacles; paths differ. Beautiful tactile precision, compact horizontal footprint, transparent outer backdrop, no fancy machinery.

An exquisitely crafted evidence-retrieval infographic. Left: a loose library of eight ivory botanical document cards, each with distinct realistic plant specimen and short printed heading: 'Fern', 'Iris', 'Moss', 'Oak', 'Rose', 'Pine', 'Algae', 'Lily'. Fine blue connectors carry the selected page into the answer, while irrelevant flower and tree pages stay behind. Small stage labels 'Question', 'Evidence', 'Answer' integrated in paper margins. A precise modern library metaphor on transparent background: an ivory index drawer containing blue-gray topic cards, two relevant lavender cards pulled forward. A question slip with a small fern silhouette lies on the left; a finished answer sheet with matching fern silhouette and two tiny numbered source tabs lies on the right. Subtle paper grain and brushed charcoal drawer edges, no gold.

An elegant wide semantic-search constellation made of twelve small opaque ivory specimen cards placed on an invisible plane, each with a natural object photograph. Three fern and moss cards cluster near a lavender query card labeled 'Shade and moisture'; shells and stones remain far away. A narrow blue selection ribbon gathers only those three relevant plant cards into a final answer sheet labeled 'Relevant evidence'. A beautiful cutaway of an ivory book whose blue-gray pages are visible as distinct layers. Three lavender bookmarked passages lift out as thin paper ribbons and converge beside an open question card into one concise ivory answer card. Botanical fern details on the chosen passages align with a fern photograph on the question. Only labels 'Retrieve', 'Read', 'Cite' engraved onto three small page tabs. A refined scientific quality-control still life, not a balance scale. A pristine ivory answer card at center-left is passed through three narrow transparent-outline inspection frames, each with an opaque pale base labeled 'Correctness', 'Evidence', 'Robustness'. Beneath them, tiny blue test cards show a check, a cited document, and three varied inputs. One muted apricot discrepancy is circled under the evidence frame. Right: an ivory answer sheet overlaid by a magnifier revealing two source excerpts represented by neat type rules and one tiny factual mismatch highlighted in muted apricot. An elegant physical test matrix, a shallow ivory panel with three rows and three columns. Column labels 'Accuracy', 'Sources', 'Consistency'; row labels 'Question 1', 'Question 2', 'Question 3'. Most cells contain small blue dots, two contain hollow lavender rings, one contains an understated apricot cross. A small stack of unseen question cards enters at left and a concise report card exits at right. This is a conceptual test suite, not actual measured performance. Extremely clean typesetting and tactile geometry; no checkered backdrop; true alpha outside objects.

A beautiful scientific specimen comparison: two nearly identical ivory factual answer cards, both polished and confident. A small fold-out blue reference document bridges them. Thin lavender annotation threads show one matching detail and one contradicted detail, the latter marked by a tiny apricot correction slip. Main integrated label 'Evidence changes the verdict'. Avoid unreadable body text: use realistic typography rules and a simple leaf illustration as the factual detail. The visual should reward close inspection, not rely on a giant check mark. Restrained horizontal paper sculpture on transparency.

A scientifically exact, elegant neuron diagram as tactile ivory paper circuitry. Three blue input tiles on left labeled 'x₁', 'x₂', 'x₃'. Each passes through a small lavender weight tile labeled 'w₁', 'w₂', 'w₃'; the three paths merge at one round ivory summation disk labeled 'Σ'. A separate small tile 'b' enters the same disk from below. One output path then passes through a blue activation tile containing a clear S-shaped curve and exits to one ivory tile 'y'. Small stage labels integrated in pale ribbon below: 'Inputs', 'Weights', 'Sum + bias', 'Activation', 'Output'. Three lines before the sum, only one after it. Zero extra branches. Beautiful scientific precision with subtle depth, no biological neuron analogy.

A refined explainer built from an ivory equation strip and one small three-dimensional curve. The strip reads exactly 'y = f(w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + b)' in beautiful graphite mathematical typography. Above the first two products, paired blue input and lavender weight tiles fit together like two multiplication pairs. Above the plus-b term a small ivory bias slider. Above f a satin blue S-curve standing in a thin open frame. Integrated tiny labels 'Weighted sum' beneath the parentheses and 'Nonlinearity' beneath f. Compact horizontal scientific still life, not an app screenshot; all symbols exact and legible, no decorative brain.

One artificial neuron shown as a beautifully restrained cutaway of a satin blue arithmetic module. On its left three numbered ivory input tabs '0.2', '0.7', '0.4' enter three lavender adjustable weight gates. Inside, three paths join in an ivory chamber marked 'Sum + bias'; then one path crosses a small S-curve wafer marked 'Activation'; on the right one blue output pin. Do not add actual output number or claim arithmetic result. Opaque labels embedded in objects. Physical metaphor but scientifically correct flow, no gears, brass or plumbing, high-end industrial editorial design.

A museum-quality flat-lay diagram built from laser-cut matte paper: three pale blue ribbons labeled 'Inputs' with tiny x symbols run through three lavender weight clips labeled 'Weights', converge into one ivory circle with sigma symbol and one small bias tab, then a single slate ribbon passes through an ivory rounded rectangle containing an S-curve and continues as 'Output'. Small label 'Activation' on curve tile. All objects on actual transparent background, crisp layered-paper shadows and subtle fiber texture, beautifully spaced. Exactly one activation after summation, no extra output paths, no equations beyond x and sigma.

A sophisticated two-row neuron anatomy plate on transparency. Top row: three blue inputs, three lavender weighted connections, one ivory sum node, one blue nonlinear curve tile, one output. Bottom narrow ivory strip holds the exact equation 'output = activation(weighted sum + bias)'. A tiny separate ivory bias block feeds directly into the sum node. Use only stage labels 'Input', 'Sum', 'Activation', 'Output' set into the nodes, no other text. The weighted connections differ subtly in thickness but all converge correctly. Elegant dimensional infographic, minimal material, precise reading order, no machine ornament.

A precise dual-row tokenization infographic with tactile paper and satin tiles. Top: an ivory phrase card reads 'The cat sleeps.'; it separates into four pale blue tiles reading 'The', ' cat', ' sleeps', '.' then four short columns of lavender numeric beads, suggesting vectors without exact IDs. Bottom: one exquisite blue butterfly photograph on an ivory card divides into exactly four square 2-by-2 patches, then these four patches line up in reading order with four small blue vector columns beside them. Small integrated row labels 'Text pieces' and 'Image patches'. No false claim that tokens always equal words. Complete photograph with all wings visible; four pieces must reconstruct the same image.

An elegant exploded-view image-token diagram. A detailed blue-and-ivory sneaker photograph on a square card is divided into a 3-by-3 grid of exactly nine square patches. The nine squares lift slightly in staggered depth while retaining their exact image alignment. To the right, nine slender lavender and blue vector bars align in a neat sequence. Small ivory labels 'Patches' under image and 'Vectors' under sequence. One thin path connects a single highlighted central patch to its vector. Actual transparency outside objects, no background grid, no made-up embedding values, restrained precise geometry.

A beautiful scientific field-guide spread floating on transparency: left an ivory paper sentence 'A small blue bird.' carefully cut into five token tiles 'A', ' small', ' blue', ' bird', '.'. Right a delicate photo of a blue bird divided into four exact square patches, each patch paired with a small lavender stack of numeric chips. Both forms lead into the same neat row of abstract blue vector tiles at center-bottom. Printed labels 'Text' and 'Image' only. All cuts align, no mismatched bird anatomy or duplicated words; visual analogy not a literal tokenizer output. Compact wide composition, no book cover.

A refined dimensional infographic about an image becoming tokens: a square botanical photograph of one muted blue iris, divided by two vertical and two horizontal cuts into nine squares. Four corners stay in place while the center and edge squares float outward just enough to reveal the patch structure. A lavender ribbon beneath orders nine corresponding miniatures left to right. The ribbon carries the exact label 'Position matters'. A small pale-blue vector capsule follows each miniature. The flower image must line up perfectly across patches, and every tile is square and complete. Transparent outside, no decorative machinery.

A concise tactile typographic sculpture: an ivory sentence strip 'Learning from examples' is split into three clearly separated illustrative pieces 'Learning', ' from', ' examples', each sitting over a small lavender numerical vector stack. Alongside it, a photo of a complete slate-blue ankle boot is neatly quartered into four patches above four matching vector stacks. One small integrated ivory note reads 'Pieces become vectors'. This is an illustrative split, no exact tokenizer IDs. Exquisite readable type, believable photo texture, controlled blue palette, compact horizontal composition with actual transparency.

An exceptionally elegant nested-containment sculpture made from four offset open oval paper bands lying horizontally in shallow three-quarter perspective. The largest ivory band labeled 'Artificial intelligence' fully contains a muted blue band labeled 'Machine learning', which fully contains a lavender band labeled 'Deep learning', which fully contains a small slate-blue band labeled 'Large language models'. Labels are printed on opaque outward-facing bands and remain fully readable, not occluded. The inner labels sit on progressively smaller front rims. No random objects, no planets, no branching diagram that implies disjoint sets. Precise physical nesting, sophisticated soft light, genuine transparent outer background.

A refined botanical taxonomy analogy rendered as an ivory folio cutout: one large rounded leaf-shaped region labeled 'Artificial intelligence', within it a clearly bounded blue region 'Machine learning', inside that lavender 'Deep learning', within that small ivory 'Large language models'. These are four nested regions, each visually contained in the previous, with labels printed on dedicated exposed ledges. The shape is an elegant topographic paper relief, not a rectangular UI card pile. Restrained depth and fine paper layers; no unrelated generative-AI region or false timeline. Wide horizontal composition with ample readable type.

A sophisticated top-down scientific atlas made of four nested thin matte ceramic contours: a large ivory oval, then blue oval, lavender oval, charcoal-blue inner oval. Contours are offset toward the right so each has a spacious exposed left area for exact labels 'AI', 'Machine learning', 'Deep learning', 'Large language models'. At far right inside the smallest region a tiny array of three ivory token tiles hints at text. All labels printed on opaque pale inserts, no floating low-contrast text. Show containment unmistakably. No decorative stones, no neon or gold, no excessive empty height.

A beautiful exploded paper nesting diagram with four thin translucent-edged but opaque-centered contour sheets, shifted slightly in depth while their boundaries remain visually nested. On exposed left tabs: 'Artificial intelligence', 'Machine learning', 'Deep learning', 'Large language models'. Each lower/smaller region is visibly a subset of the preceding broader region, indicated by precise continuous contour outlines. Matte ivory, powder blue, mist lavender, slate blue. Wide shallow composition, sophisticated museum infographic, no concentric bullseye target or numeric hierarchy, all full text readable.

An elegant literal set-inclusion illustration: four open architectural arches nested horizontally, outer ivory arch 'AI', next powder-blue arch 'Machine learning', next lavender arch 'Deep learning', innermost slate arch 'Large language models'. Each arch has a thin floor boundary extending to enclose the smaller arches, making subset relationship clear rather than a sequence. Labels set on wide opaque front-facing lintels with perfect letterforms. A few tiny text tiles only inside the innermost chamber. chapters.chapter: Language, one token at a time
variants: A scientifically careful three-stage paper transformer infographic. Left an ivory sentence strip 'The cat sat on the' split into five blue token tiles. Middle two stacked lavender sheets: the first shows fine attention links between five positions; the second shows five transformed blue vector columns. Right three ivory candidate tiles with bars of visibly different lengths labeled 'mat', 'floor', 'chair'. A thin looping arrow returns the selected 'mat' tile to the end of the input sentence. Small stage labels 'Context', 'Transformer', 'Next token' embedded in pale sheets. Do not imply exact probabilities or reveal model reasoning; attention links are illustrative. Precise connections, no fake code, beautiful typography, compact on transparency.

A refined exploded book-page metaphor for a transformer. On left a narrow ivory sentence ribbon 'A blue bird can' separates into four small token blocks. At center a short stack of six blue and lavender paper layers with subtle inter-token connecting threads illustrates repeated attention and transformation. At right three candidate word tiles 'fly', 'sing', 'rest' have blue likelihood bars, and 'fly' lifts forward as one sampled continuation. Label tabs read 'Context', 'Repeated blocks', 'Prediction'. No percentages, no claim of thoughts, no brains. Elegant scientifically meaningful layered paper, complete readable text and clean alpha.

A sophisticated flat-lay infographic: an ivory phrase strip 'The key is on the' runs along bottom-left; above it a compact six-by-six attention matrix with several soft blue highlighted cells sits next to a lavender feed-forward block, enclosed together by one thin brace labeled 'Transformer block'. Three subtle overlapping copies behind indicate repetition. To the right a clean ivory card labeled 'Next token' shows three candidate rows 'table', 'shelf', 'desk' with restrained blue bars. An elegant sculptural language loom made of six opaque ivory word tiles 'A', 'small', 'boat', 'crossed', 'the', 'lake'. Thin muted blue threads connect the last tile back to relevant earlier tiles, feeding a small lavender transformation stack, followed by three punctuation/word candidate tiles '.', 'at', 'and'. A pale label on the stack reads 'Attention + transformation'; a small output label reads 'One token, then repeat'. No gold mechanical loom, no glowing cables, no pseudo equations. A beautiful dimensional editorial diagram showing language generation as a feedback loop: a horizontal row of ivory token tiles reading 'The sky is', followed by an empty tile; beneath, a compact slate-blue transformer stack receives all visible tiles via thin blue lines. To the right, a lavender fan of alternatives 'blue', 'clear', 'bright' converges to one selected 'blue' tile that moves along one curved arrow into the empty slot. Labels printed on opaque tabs 'Read context', 'Predict', 'Append'. Scientifically clear loop, no hidden chain-of-thought, no invented percentages. Soft studio lighting on matte paper and ceramic, transparent backdrop.

An elegant clear agent-loop infographic built from four tactile ivory cards arranged in a compact horizontal oval. Left card 'Goal' with small checklist; upper middle blue card 'Model' with a small token pattern; right lavender card 'Tool' with a tiny calculator; lower middle ivory card 'Result' with a tiny table. Arrows: Goal into Model, Model to Tool, Tool to Result, Result back to Model. A separate short exit from Model leads to a small 'Done' tab. Exactly those connections, no extra arrows or anthropomorphic brain. Precise flat-lay paper sculpture, rich restrained texture, readable labels, transparent outside objects.

A sophisticated practical agent example on transparency: a question card 'Compare two prices' enters a blue model card, which calls a lavender browser tool card showing two simple product price tags; its result sheet returns along a curved blue path to the model, and a final ivory comparison table emerges. Tiny integrated labels 'Request tool', 'Observe result', 'Continue or finish'. The model and tool are separate objects; no claim that model itself browses without software. No actual brands or live prices needed, use $12 and $15 as illustrative amounts. Exact text, restrained elegant paper materials.

A refined architectural loop of four shallow satin blocks labeled 'Goal', 'Choose', 'Act', 'Observe', connected by thin blue paths. Goal leads to Choose; Choose leads to Act; Act leads to Observe; Observe returns to Choose. A small ivory exit branch labeled 'Finish' leaves Choose. On Act only, three miniature tool symbols engraved in blue: calculator, file, magnifier. No robots, no gears, no giant terminal.
